annotations.title: Watch a name, company or plate for 30 days (paid)

description: Use when the user wants to be told later: watches one item for 30 days, paid once, no account. kind=sanctions (a name, re-screened when the EU, UN, UK or US lists change), company (COUNTRY:name or number, register checked daily) or apk (Dutch plate, daily). Alerts go to webhook and to /v1/watch/alerts with the returned token. Input: kind, value, optional webhook, label. Costs 0.05 USDC via x402, or 25 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

value.description: Name, COUNTRY:company (e.g. IE:Ryanair) or Dutch plate
